title: Use Venice AI (@AskVenice) to run Seedance 2.0 prompts up to 10k characters…
content:
Use Venice AI (@AskVenice) to run Seedance 2.0 prompts up to 10k characters (instead of typical 3500–4000) for longer, more detailed prompting with full adherence.  
In @AskVenice Studio → Edit, input your main image and prompt GPT2 (16:9) to generate a character sheet: Make me a character sheet of [subject] on a white background, with a front, side, and back profile.  
After generating character sheets, place them onto 1080×1440 canvases in Photoshop/Canva (or any editor) and use these composites as Seedance reference images to prevent Seedance from locking onto a single frame and to keep prompt flexibility.  
For better continuity across scenes, take screenshots from earlier video scenes and feed them to the LLM alongside your existing references, explicitly stating they are references from the previous scene.

cont. 👇

Una vez que tengas esas hojas de personaje, vas a entrar en Photoshop, Canva, cualquier editor de fotos, y colocarlas en lienzos de 1080 por 1440 y hacer que se vean así, y usarlas como tus referencias.

Esto evitará que Seedance se fije en tu cuadro, dándote la máxima flexibilidad de prompt.
